title: Azeneths Angels - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 2 NPCs from Azeneths Angels.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Azeneths Angels (Azeneths Angels.esp).

Install this if Azeneths Angels.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
